SFX_CaveAmbience_Loop.processing: Synthesized: rumble, air, wind moan, distant drips and pebbles, circular cave reverb.

SFX_TorchCrackle_Loop.processing: Synthesized: flickering low roar, gas hiss, clustered crackles and pops, built circularly.

SFX_Drip_01.processing: Synthesized: rising-pitch drop with a tick, short cave reverb.

SFX_Drip_02.processing: Synthesized: rising-pitch drop with a tick, short cave reverb.

SFX_Drip_03.processing: Synthesized: rising-pitch drop with a tick, short cave reverb.

SFX_Spikes_Arm.processing: metalLatch as the click; lowFrequency_explosion_001 low-passed at 250 Hz as a knock; synthesized grinding rumble that swells over 0.3 s; small room.

SFX_Spikes_Rise.processing: drawKnife3 cut to 60 ms before its peak as the scrape; impactMetal_heavy_001 clang and impactMining_003 (low-passed 1.2 kHz) at the peak; synthesized 85-45 Hz thump; small room.

SFX_Spikes_Retract.processing: drawKnife2 slowed to 0.7x (lower) and high-passed as the slide; synthesized grind sweeping 1.2 kHz to 500 Hz; impactMining_002 low-passed at 900 Hz plus a synthesized thump as the end clunk at 0.62 s.

SFX_DartLauncher_Arm.processing: beltHandle2 as the ratchet, with a +6 dB resonance at 700 Hz for body; creak3 slowed to 0.9x at -12 dB underneath; small room.

SFX_DartLauncher_Fire_01.processing: impactWood_medium_000 cut to 0.18 s as the mechanism clack; synthesized air puff (band-pass sweeping 3.5 kHz to 1.1 kHz) and a 200 Hz tube "thoomp"; small room.

SFX_DartLauncher_Fire_02.processing: impactWood_medium_003 cut to 0.18 s as the mechanism clack; synthesized air puff (band-pass sweeping 3.5 kHz to 1.1 kHz) and a 170 Hz tube "thoomp"; small room.

SFX_Dart_Whoosh.processing: knifeSlice2 shaped by a bell envelope around its loudest point and high-passed at 900 Hz; synthesized flyby (band-pass sweeping up to 3 kHz and back) under it.

SFX_Dart_Impact_01.processing: chop cut to 0.24 s as the hit; synthesized shaft quiver at 165 Hz; small room.

SFX_Dart_Impact_02.processing: impactPlank_medium_001 cut to 0.35 s as the hit; synthesized shaft quiver at 215 Hz; small room.

SFX_Dart_Impact_03.processing: impactMining_002 low-passed at 3 kHz and cut to 0.25 s; impactMetal_medium_004 at -6 dB; impactWood_medium_003 sped up 1.5x as two bounces at 0.11 s and 0.19 s; small room.

SFX_SwingLog_Whoosh.processing: knifeSlice slowed to 0.4x, shaped by a bell around its loudest point and low-passed at 2.5 kHz; synthesized low band-pass sweep (180-630 Hz) and a 55 Hz sub swell.
